facts.rationale: Removes the unsupported retained-score input while preserving the canonical handler's actual producer-consumer behavior.
facts.value: Consumes the selected controller's trigger mask and shared phase, selection, controller-related fields, balances, continuation cost, and selector animation records. It updates selection and phase, requests selector/material animations, emits feedback, and on affordable Continue deducts cost from displayed units and cost times ten from the backing balance, enables payment animation, and initializes transition frames. Phase-8 completion selects phase 9 or 10. It neither reads nor decrements the stored score; score reduction occurs in fn_8019F810.
